name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin 10% off its high; Binance still under stress after $6.3bn theft
state: Bitcoin was near $77,600 on 3 Nov, about 10% below its 52-week high, which alone would be Normal. Watch rests on Binance, a top-10 exchange, still under stress after the FBI said North Korea stole about $6.3bn; Pyongyang denied it on 3 Nov (Euronews). Bitcoin ETFs saw about $399m of outflows and Coinbase fell 4% on 2 Nov after a downgrade citing the hack (Saxo).
for_you: Crypto holdings on exchanges carry counterparty risk; exchange failures and thefts are not covered by deposit protection schemes.
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: Euronews — North Korea slams FBI claims over Binance hack

why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
